scope: Retrospective analysis; no confirmatory H1/H2 test or Sprint 54 result. Three independent seeds; temporal rows are dependent.

convention.D_H: H(source) - H(production): positive is entropy loss, negative is entropy gain

hypothesis_labels.validation: Leave one of three independent seeds out; separately fit generations 1-10 and evaluate 11-15. Retrospective comparisons only.

forecast_provenance.kind: base conditional entropy-price curve minus signed calibration budget; no fitted temporal response model

timing.scope: Saved per-generation wall times, including their recorded work; not pure CUDA kernel time. Earlier goal-accounting elapsed time is separate.
